raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
UBS Role: Business Analyst (April 2025 – Till Date)
Partnered with stakeholders to gather and document requirements for regulatory reporting (FR Y-14Q).
Designed workflows and data mapping for collateral & margin processes. • Coordinated with technology teams to implement system enhancements, reducing reporting errors by 20%.
Conducted UAT and prepared BRDs, FSDs, and gap analysis documents. • Supported daily, monthly and quarterly P&L and exposure reporting for Equity and Derivative products.
Performed analysis of P&L movements, trade mismatches and position-related breaks.
Worked on collateral and margin management, including investigation and resolution of discrepancies.
Coordinated with Front Office, Risk and Settlements teams for resolution of P&L, trade, position and collateral breaks.
Analysed reporting outputs and investigated exceptions to identify root causes and ensure accurate reporting.
Supported process controls and reporting requirements to reduce operational risk.
Credit Suisse Role: Business Analyst (Aug 2021 – Mar 2025)
Prime Brokerage / Equity Swap Trade Management
Worked closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements, operational issues and process changes.
Performed AS-IS / TO-BE analysis and identified process gaps and improvement opportunities.
Supported automation and process enhancement initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
Performed data analysis, reconciliation and exception investigation across Investment Banking processes.
Coordinated with Technology and Operations teams for issue resolution and implementation of process changes.
Supported functional testing, UAT and post-implementation activities. • Prepared process documentation and provided support during implementation and BAU transition.
Supported automation initiatives aimed at reducing manual processing and improving operational efficiency.
Analysed existing workflows and identified opportunities to eliminate manual activities and reduce operational risk.
Worked with Technology teams to translate business/process requirements into functional changes.
Participated in testing and validation of enhancements before implementation. • Performed root-cause analysis of operational exceptions and coordinated corrective actions.
Supported stakeholders throughout the requirement, testing, implementation and post- production support lifecycle.
UBS Securities Specialist – Corporate Actions (July 2019 – July 2021)
Managed end-to-end Corporate Action processing across multiple markets. • Analysed corporate action announcements and ensured accurate event setup and processing.
Worked with internal teams and stakeholders to resolve exceptions and discrepancies.
Supported event validation, elections, processing and reconciliation activities. • Investigated breaks and exceptions and coordinated with relevant teams for timely resolution.
Performed UAT and functional validation for process/system changes. • Prepared and maintained MIS, exception reports and process documentation. • Identified opportunities to simplify processes and improve operational efficiency. • Worked with technology teams to raise and track system-related issues and defects.
Deutsche Bank – Process Supervisor - Corporate Actions (Feb 2015 – June 2019)
Process knowledge of SWIFT ISO 15022 MESSAGES MT564, MT565, MT566, MT567 & MT568
Processed all mandatory corporate action transactions. And elections part of Voluntary instructions. This includes monitoring notifications, sending letters to appropriate parties, entering instructions with depositories/agents, and posting transactions to accounting system in a timely, accurate and complete manner. • All types of reconciliation for events Invalid fail breaks, intersystem breaks, cash
breaks.
Setting up of the events once it got captured and event get created by validation team.
Researching on the events on their Critical information to cross verify in case of any discrepancies.
Tackling queries through mails to Research, Payments and controls team in prudent manner. Handled Escalations and queries via emails, calls received from the vendors and control teams.
Maintaining Sop's of the process on timely manner if any changes happen in process.
